items.title: dsh-superagent-prototype
items.description: Towards a More Autonomous Agent System
items.summary: DeepSeek AI published dsh-superagent, a proactive coding agent prototype for DeepSeek Harness, on GitHub on 2026-10-31. The team describes it as research code from day-to-day development work, not an official DeepSeek product, and much of the engineering was completed by coding agents. The prototype listens to GitHub and, optionally, Feishu; when an authorized person requests work, it opens a work item, processes it in its own session, and answers in the original conversation with a pull request. The design aims to reduce the human attention an agent demands by acting only when asked or when a rule allows it, and it speaks only when someone must act or can use a result. A web panel surfaces the items that still require a person. The team notes that the code is intended for reference and adaptation, not as a production product.

items.title: agent-autoloop
items.description: 让你的命令行 Agent 在后台自己接活、自己跟进到底；平时不烦你，遇到拿不准的事才发卡片找你拍板。
items.summary: Agent Autoloop is an open-source automation platform designed to address the issue of command line AI assistants not being able to run autonomously in the background. It allows AI agents to automatically handle tasks and follow through without constant supervision, only notifying users for decisions on uncertain operations. It supports scheduled tasks and external event triggers, provides a clear overview of task execution, and is suitable for developers who frequently use command line AI assistants for coding and automation but prefer not to constantly monitor the terminal. The tool is available on GitHub and requires Node 24, Git, curl, and a logged-in command line AI assistant environment for macOS and Linux systems.

items.title: Google_AI_Pro_2Year_ZeroCost_Auto
items.description: Google_AI_Pro_2Year_ZeroCost_Auto
items.summary: The GitHub repository for Google_AI_Pro_2Year_ZeroCost_Auto provides a tool that allows users to activate Google AI Pro (5 TB) for 24 months at US$0.00 without any device or payment. The tool requires Windows 10/11, Google Chrome, and Python 3.10 or higher. It automates the process of binding a Visa or Mastercard for zero cost, importing Google accounts, and activating the service through a series of automated steps. The automation tool ensures no charges are applied by verifying the cost before proceeding with the subscription. The Google AI Developers Forum also confirms the possibility of activating the service for 24 months at zero cost without any device or payment.

items.title: cicada

items.summary: Cicada is an open-source tool for real-time subtitles, interpreting, and AI meeting notes on macOS. It supports Zoom, Tencent Meeting, Feishu, and YouTube for real-time bilingual subtitles and AI meeting notes. It can translate spoken language into another language and transmit it to meeting software via a virtual microphone. It is available for Mac, Windows, Linux, and Android. The tool is free and open-source under the Apache-2.0 license, allowing for personal, commercial, or closed-source redistribution. It offers real-time translation, meeting notes updated every 45 seconds, speaker recognition in experimental phase, and uses Ling and Ming-3.0 models for its functionalities.

items.title: sand3d

items.summary: sand3d is a Python library for 3D modeling built for LLMs, allowing users to write 3D objects as short programs over Blender's `bpy`. It enables the creation of 3D models by describing shapes in a few hundred tokens, which can be read and modified by a person. The repository on GitHub indicates it is licensed under Apache-2.0 and supports Python 3.11 and 3.13 with Blender versions 4.5 and 5.2. The GitHub trending stats show a recent surge in activity, with 452 stars gained over three days in November 2026. The project also highlights its capability to generate 3D assets using Python code, which can be reused, modified, and exported for various applications.

items.title: hermes-voice
items.description: Talk to a Hermes Agent profile through Home Assistant Assist
items.summary: The Hermes-Voice integration allows Home Assistant to communicate with the Hermes Agent server over WebSocket, enabling Hermes to appear in the Preferred conversation agent selector under Settings → Voice assistants. The integration registers a Home Assistant Assist conversation agent (`HermesConversationAgent`) on the `Platform.CONVERSATION` platform and handles both incoming `assist_query` and outgoing `assist_response` WebSocket messages. Hermes Agent supports full voice interaction across CLI and messaging platforms, allowing users to have live voice conversations in Discord voice channels. Hermes Agent does not require any client-side configuration, and keys are held in the desktop's memory for the session only, never written to disk on the client.

items.title: roblox-studio-mcp
items.description: Model Context Protocol server for Roblox Studio. Connect AI assistants (Claude, Cursor) to read object trees, edit scripts, and run playtests safely. Open-source and lightweight
items.summary: The Roblox Studio MCP server is built into Roblox Studio and implements the Model Context Protocol (MCP), an open standard that allows AI tools to securely communicate with external applications. This server enables AI clients to interact directly with an open Studio session, exploring the data model, writing scripts, running Luau code, and testing games in play mode. The open-source standalone MCP server on GitHub is no longer actively developed, and the built-in MCP server in Roblox Studio is now recommended for connecting external AI tools. The built-in server uses Rust, similar to the open-source one, and will eventually be open-sourced. The timeline for this is not yet available.

items.title: vork
items.description: Headless 3D and VFX engine for agents. Research preview.
items.summary: vork is a headless 3D and VFX engine for AI agents, developed by Voyager. It is written in Rust and Slang and renders on the GPU through Vulkan and Metal. The engine is a research preview, released on 6 November 2026, and is source-available, not open source. It is free during the research preview, including for commercial work within a company of any size. The engine allows agents to write a scene as code, render it, review the result, and revise the code. It does not include an editor, timeline, or window. The research preview has limitations such as fog and volumes not yet implemented, heavy interiors potentially aborting on Mac, and a slower path tracer compared to Cycles.

items.title: NextTransformer
items.description: :sunrise: A comprehensive, cutting-edge open-source framework for next-generation Transformers/LLM, with compute-matched benchmarking and a platform for autonomous architecture research.
items.summary: As of mid-2026, pure non-transformer architectures remain roughly 5 to 10 percentage points behind standard transformers on general benchmarks, with no pure non-transformer model achieving state-of-the-art on major public leaderboards. The probability of a non-transformer LLM achieving SOTA before the end of 2027 is estimated at 7%, due to the significant financial risk and lack of demonstrated superiority of non-transformer models compared to attention-based models and hybrids. Meanwhile, the GitHub repository for Transformers lists dozens of architectures and over 60,000 pretrained models, emphasizing the dominance of transformer-based models in the field.

A team from Zhejiang University has created an open-source alternative called nanoMuse, which is available under the GPL-3.0 license. This alternative aims to replicate the functionalities of Muse, including the ability to operate across multiple devices, with user actions requiring approval through a Sentinel system, and the option to deploy the memory and model on personal servers. items.title: lancer
items.description: Lancer — desktop AI workspace based on pi-gui and pi
items.summary: pi-gui is a native desktop visual shell for the pi coding agent, designed to organize parallel coding work without forcing developers to parse raw terminal streams. It provides a persistent desktop workspace for AI-powered coding sessions with full visibility into what the agent is doing and why. The desktop shell is separated from the agent runtime through a durable SessionDriver interface, making the frontend independent of backend changes and ready for future runtime swaps. pi-gui is available in beta for macOS arm64 and Linux AppImage, installable from GitHub Releases or Homebrew on macOS.

items.summary: gputaskman is a GPU task manager developed by Microsoft engineer Scott Hanselman, available on GitHub. The tool aims to offer granular GPU usage details, addressing the vagueness of Windows Task Manager, and is available as a portable build without installation. It monitors what's using GPU memory, including LLMs, browsers, the compositor, and renderers.

items.title: uni-robot-agent

items.summary: uni-robot-agent is a unified and modular harness for robot use without privileged inputs, designed for generalizable agentic training. It unifies interaction records across environments and supports efficient experience collection for open models. The tool interfaces and feedback formats span models, robots, tasks, and environments, making simulation and real-world experience easier to combine for training. The open-source project includes a CLI, Python SDK, local dashboard, and simulator integrations, and it supports environments like RoboDojo, RoboUse, and RoboLab. items.title: open-bot-avatar
items.description: A JSON spec and renderer for interactive agent avatars
items.summary: The sources describe "open-bot-avatar" as a JSON specification and renderer for interactive agent avatars, specifically defining an avatar as a single SVG path within a `0 0 100 100` box plus eye placement. The renderer creates a 3D-looking SVG avatar, inferred from the outline as stacked cross-sections and drawn in a CSS 3D scene or projected into a flat SVG for stills. The avatar definition is in v1 JSON format with `id`, `name`, `body.path`, and eye coordinates. The repository is MIT licensed, has 95 stars, 18 watchers, and 13 forks. The avatar renderer is part of a larger real-time avatar system involving ASR, LLM, TTS, lip-sync renderer, and WebRTC.

It accepts `tools` and `tool_choice` for function calling and supports `response_format` for JSON output, though without JSON-schema enforcement. items.title: open-source-hands
items.description: Make webcam hand games in the browser, or point your coding agent here and have it make one. MediaPipe hand tracking + a gesture engine + a starter game + a playbook.
items.summary: The GitHub repository open-source-hands by abouchedidxcode provides a framework for making webcam hand games in the browser using MediaPipe hand tracking, a gesture engine, a starter game, and a playbook. The project includes a dependency-free TypeScript kit on top of Google's MediaPipe Hand Landmarker, which identifies 21 points on each hand. The kit translates these points into game-ready input, including 20 poses, 16 motions, 5 two-hand gestures, and continuous values like pinch strength and palm position. MediaPipe itself is Google's open-source framework for on-device machine learning, which outputs 21 hand-knuckle coordinates per hand, and is released under the Apache 2.0 license.

items.title: ai-java-workflow
items.description: ☕ 用 AI 辅助 Java / Spring Boot 研发（AI for Java / AI for Spring）｜需求、实现、测试、审查与交付｜Graph → Loop → Workflow → Agent / Skill、虚构可运行案例及 worktree / Docker 工具｜面向业务开发，非 Spring AI 框架实现
items.summary: The sources indicate that for Java/Spring Boot development with AI assistance, the choice of framework depends on specific project needs. For simple AI dialogues and RAG, Spring AI is recommended. For complex multi-Agent coordination and task scheduling, Spring AI Alibaba is suggested. For a comprehensive toolset and Python ecosystem integration, LangChain4j is preferred. For enterprise-level smooth upgrades and standardized protocol access, AgentScope-Java and MCP Java SDK are recommended. The sources also mention that Spring AI Alibaba's StateGraph allows for custom workflow definitions, combining non-LLM steps with LLM/Agent steps in flexible control structures.

items.title: best-agent-memory-mcp
items.description: Best Agent Memory MCP servers, ranked and compared: long-term memory for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and any MCP client. Glen, Mem0, Supermemory, Zep, Hindsight, Basic Memory, claude-mem, Graphiti, Cognee, the official memory server and more, with storage, capture model, team sharing, license and live stars.
items.summary: The sources provide specific details about three memory servers: Mem0, Cognee, and Supermemory. Mem0, founded in 2023 by Embedchain Inc. in San Francisco, California, is an AI memory layer that enhances agents' intelligence through continuous learning from past interactions. Cognee, founded in 2024 by cognee inc. in Berlin, Germany, is an open-source agent memory platform that allows LLM agents to capture and recall context across sessions. Supermemory, based in San Francisco, California, is a context engineering platform that powers enterprise APIs, developer plugins, and a personal app that remembers everything. Supermemory also has web traffic metrics including 244,205 monthly visits and a global rank of 153,891.
